reviews.comment: I chose Four Paws Inn via google about a week before my trip and it was the best decision! Amanda was incredibly efficient, communicative, and accommodating when it came to leaving my elderly dog in her care. I was very nervous going into this because I’ve never left him at a dog hotel before and he is a very anxious boy, but Amanda truly made this process so smooth and reassuring for both me and my dog. After a brief meet and greet, I was sure that my dog would be just fine for the week I was gone. The location is clean and well kept, the yard is huge, and there are even separate rooms if the dogs wanted to be left alone. Every morning and night I received picture/video updates and was able to ask questions on how he was doing. I wouldn’t hesitate to book with Amanda, this was an amazing experience!
